name: Sylvia Vesper
original_name: シルヴィア・ヴェスパー
source:
★The naughty and dangerous super magician who has Tsukasa under her thumb★

She is a highly skilled magician, recognized as such by both herself and others. She is a woman of great vitality who has absolute confidence in her abilities and always follows her own path. She is a beautiful woman with an intelligent and seductive aura, and she also has an outstanding figure.

At first glance, she appears to be egocentric, careless, and arrogant, but behind the scenes she has a big sister-like side to her, looking out for her students in various ways.

She loves drinking and bathing, and is always humming while drinking in the bathroom. She often bosses Tsukasa around and makes him take care of her personal needs.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
